recipe.recipe_note: 64 completions per optimizer step = 8 prompts x 8 samples (2 per micro-batch x 32 accumulation). LoRA LR ~10x the full-FT GRPO LR (LoRA Without Regret).
recipe.note: GPU smoke for TRL + colocated vLLM + LoRA + reward + checkpoint mirror at the real batch shape (8 prompts x 8 samples). Every completion is forced to the full max_completion_length (vLLM min_tokens), so memory and speed are the worst case of the real run; truncated completions stay in the loss here so the backward pass is real. Starts from the base model.
